name: redact
description: Keeps secrets that tools print (keys, tokens, passwords, private keys) out of what the model reads and the next request sends

prompts.title: Redact your prompts too
prompts.description: Also hide secrets you paste into a prompt (off: a key you hand over on purpose reaches the model)

generic.title: Secret-named values
generic.description: Also hide values under secret-looking names (DB_PASSWORD=..., "apiKey": "...") that have no known format

patterns.title: Extra patterns
patterns.description: Regular expressions whose matches are hidden as [redacted:custom]

allow.title: Never redact
allow.description: Exact values that are not secrets (a public test key, a sample token)
